name: MiMo Code
description: Runs Xiaomi's terminal coding agent with build, plan, and compose modes, persistent project memory, subagents, and scripted multi-agent workflows across any mainstream model provider.

skills.name: Persistent Project Memory
skills.description: Keeps project memory, session checkpoints, notes, and task progress in SQLite FTS5 and injects them when a session resumes.

skills.name: Goal Stop Condition
skills.description: Sets a stopping condition with /goal and has an independent judge model check it before the agent is allowed to end its run.

skills.name: Multi-Agent Workflows
skills.description: Runs deterministic JavaScript workflows such as compose, deep-research, fact-check, and research-experiment across parallel agents.

skills.name: Dream And Distill
skills.description: Extracts lasting knowledge from recent sessions into project memory with /dream, and packages repeated workflows as skills with /distill.
